decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment costs little to keep in the range, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
A sweet pastry fits the established confectionery offer, and absent evidence of falling short of aspirations, routine-based retention is likely.
A crusty farmhouse bread draws on existing craft knowledge and production capacity, so the firm's slack lets it carry the product at low risk.
The gold award for the poppy seed stollen and its dedicated web page show results above aspiration, making it a valued seasonal specialty.
The gold-awarded premium stollen exceeds quality aspirations and supports the firm's heritage gift positioning, so dropping it is unlikely.
